# Trevillyan Labs

> Trevillyan Labs is an independent software studio that ships custom software for clients, operates its own products, and advises founders and early-stage startups on product and go-to-market execution. The studio runs lean on agentic AI — run by founder Bill Trevillyan and operated day-to-day by an AI assistant (Ren) — which is the lived proof behind the AI work it advises on.

The site's priority job is to get visitors to hire the studio (Build + Advise). Owned products (e.g. NewsNook) appear as credibility proof and link out to their own sites.

Full content (all offerings, case studies, patents, FAQ): https://www.trevillyanlabs.io/llms-full.txt

Per-page Markdown: most pages have a Markdown mirror at their URL + `.md` (e.g. https://www.trevillyanlabs.io/services.md).

## What we do

- **Build** — Contract software development (full-stack applications: MVPs, internal tools, custom products) and high-craft web/portfolio sites, taken from idea to production.
- **Advise** — Product and go-to-market execution for founders and early-stage startups: product strategy, path to product-market fit, go-to-market, fundraising, and team building. Plus a secondary line, applying AI for leaders (where agents/assistants/automation fit). From a 3x founder who ships live products.
- **Products** — The studio builds and operates its own software. NewsNook is live in production today.

## Proof points (docs-supported)

- **NewsNook** — an AI newsletter reader, built, shipped, and operated by the studio; live in production at https://www.newsnook.ai
- **Verbaly** — an AI speech coach (LLM + RAG); launched to 2,300+ users; funded by Jason Calacanis & LAUNCH.
- **Clip Automation** — as the contract product lead (hire #1), delivered the MVP, the founding engineering team, and 7-figure ARR for an early-stage industrial-IoT startup.
- **Patents** — two issued US patents in fluid-detection fabric technology (US 11,788,918 B2; US 12,123,807 B2), available for commercial licensing.
- **Run on AI** — the studio is operated day-to-day with an AI assistant, the agentic operating model it advises on.

## Founder

- **Bill (William) Trevillyan** — product leader and 3x startup founder, based in Mountain View, CA. Named inventor on the studio's two issued US patents.

## How to engage

- Start at the contact page (https://www.trevillyanlabs.io/contact) — choose the intent (build, web/portfolio, advisory, applying AI, patent licensing, or NewsNook). Warm advisory leads can book a 30-minute call directly.
